decision: Canonical facts and attributed observer state remain separate. Observer text, confidence, summaries, rumor propagation and knowledge references cannot replace fact records or grant authority to rewrite their history.
qualification: Bounded existing production model and registered witness contract. Executable evidence belongs to the attempt's exact build/command receipts; this fixture does not claim those commands ran.
original_acceptance: The named outcome has actual source/build-bound evidence; unsupported, pending, failed and unperformed checks remain explicit.
original_verification: Freeze the cited source decision and a bounded contract example; compare observer state cannot overwrite facts. Retain decision, alternatives and unresolved facts.
Exact executable commands: TBD at G01 and scoped prerequisite resolution; this planned procedure is not a claim that Rust/browser/provider checks ran.

ownership.model: Checkpoint privately owns GameState and exposes an immutable reference. GameFact retains exact identity, operation, revision, ordinal, causal fact and audience. KnowledgeGrant points to existing canonical evidence; AttributedClaim and MemoryEpisode retain their own attribution/text.
ownership.knowledge: Pure bounded perception/ranking proposals over supplied current permitted evidence; no independent fact commitment.
ownership.engine: WitnessGrantHandler revalidates the native producer and stages knowledge grants plus a decision with no newly declared facts. Original fact/cause records remain unchanged.
ownership.session: Only the durable session owner admits and commits the staged candidate under operation/revision/fence, before publication.
ownership.persistence: Versioned checkpoint mapping and durable canonical records, not summary-derived reconstruction.
ownership.projection: Current audience authorization before serialization; a fact reference alone confers neither disclosure nor mutation rights.

bounded_example.source_policy: Synthetic admitted fixture references; not a qualified 2024 rules catalogue, real actor authentication or real perception producer.

observer.knowledge: Member 3 references fact 71 and source fact 70.
observer.belief: Actor 4 falsely believes no resource was spent.
observer.memory: Actor 4 remembers having six resources afterward.
observer.rumor: A bounded transmission retains the attributed claim and fact evidence.
observer.journal: An attributed recollection is stored separately.
observer.summary: Derived recollection binds episode, claim, historical revision and source digest; uncertain text stays derived.

procedures.input: Edit claim/memory/journal/summary text and bounded rumor progress, then remove only these synthetic derived records.
procedures.expected: Exact fact values, identities, cause, operation, historical revision, accepted decision, resources, draws, game time, checkpoint basis and pins survive. Original detached checkpoint remains unchanged.
Typed InvalidReference or ContentMismatch; no usable rejected checkpoint and no mutation of original.

procedures.input: Remove canonical facts and decisions; retain each of knowledge, belief, memory or a summary independently so no unrelated decision check masks the reference gate.
procedures.expected: Typed InvalidReference for absent fact or episode. Observer text cannot fabricate a canonical source.

alternatives.rejected_because: Observer edits erase attribution and can retcon canonical history.
A derived aid becomes an authority and loses exact committed evidence.

alternatives.choice: Deliver full canonical truth and let clients hide it
alternatives.rejected_because: Thin client hiding cannot enforce current audience authorization.

alternatives.choice: Reuse the old private marker harness as current production proof
alternatives.rejected_because: Historical std-only fixture invented bounded claim markers; current production KnowledgeGrant references actual facts rather than supplying replacement values. Historical PASS remains separately attributed.

unresolved_and_unperformed.fact: Checkpoint::new accepts a trusted complete GameState; structural validation alone is not a public client capability fence. Canonical mutation authority is owned by engine/session admission.

Checkpoint validation checks references, source digest, revision and bounds. It does not interpret natural-language truth or quarantine inconsistent summaries. Current text acceptance proves absence of canonical mutation, not source-consistent summary generation.
The example removes synthetic derived records only; it does not qualify production obligation preservation, active-fact retention or full memory decay policy.
Historical fact/cause preservation is exercised; a complete explicit world-fact supersession protocol is not admitted by this example.

Authentication/noninterference, native perception policy, retrieval/consolidation, PostgreSQL restart, redaction/restore, browser/gameplay, provider/audio/device and full rules catalogue acceptance are not proven by this bounded model decision.
